training: d11 p=.03; exact unchanged mwpm_decode Criterion corpus; inspect baseline steady-state perf and candidate test-only work counts
ablation: current main / neighbour-only / neighbour+queued-now guards, two mirrored three-arm blocks at d11 before held-out results; retain all samples
primary: six unchanged Criterion sparse arms d=7,9,11,13,15,17 p=.03, 256 fixed shots; four mirrored three-arm blocks (historical/current/candidate), rotate first arm; CLI sample-size15 (existing benchmark retains its large-distance group override; actual samples recorded), warm1s, measurement3s; no deleted samples
python: current/candidate exact bench_mwpm_allocations fixtures/helper: d5 20000 shots, d9 5000, p=.003 seed1, one Rayon thread; two ABBA blocks, seven samples/process; exact prediction SHA256
adoption: >=1.05x vs current main at d11 with all four paired block ratios >1; no aggregate regression >5% on any held-out Criterion/Python case. Otherwise document/revert non-beneficial guard(s), never change matching semantics to reach a timing target.
issue_target: Only claim #511 1.5x target met if fresh same-host historical/current/candidate inputs agree and candidate beats historical by >=1.5x at d11 in aggregate and every block. Never multiply historical ratios from separate campaigns.
correctness: old scanner exact transition assertions in native unit builds; existing 100500-shot dense optimum/tie and error-estimate suites, circuit-level differential, proptests, PyMatching oracle, zero warmed decode_into allocations, serial/parallel determinism
host: same idle physical CPU/SMT sibling for all timed processes, wait <10% overall and <1.1% benchmark core/sibling before runs; pin CPU, log per-second sibling/overall activity; leave services/CI running; no parallel builds/tests during timings
no_claim: No improved matching quality, changed rounding/precision, event ordering, heap or graph algorithms. No added production diagnostic counters. Results apply to measured fixtures on shared CPU host.
summary_rule: Median of process-level Criterion mean point estimates; two observations/arm/block, eight/arm overall. Report each native bootstrap interval and all raw samples; no pooled confidence interval. Python medians include all 28 rate samples/version/case.
amendment_reason: Initial d11 training saw intermittent SMT activity and no clear neighbour-only benefit. Preserve every observation; compare queued-only against both guards before held-out measurements. Do not use training to claim acceptance speedups.
guard_ablation: Two mirrored two-arm blocks of both guards / queued-only at d11, before held-out results; retain all samples.
primary_host_validity: Before held-out measurements, require every one-second process sample to have <=10% total and <=5% SMT-sibling activity. A violation invalidates/stops the whole campaign; retain all attempted results, no per-sample deletion or automatic retry.
neighbour_retention_rule: Keep neighbour filtering only if both-guards beats queued-only by >=1.02x in aggregate and in each of the two training blocks. Otherwise prefer the smaller queued-only change before held-out measurements.
